When a quotation travels

First, check whether words were copied ____2____. An altered verb or missing negative can reverse a sentence. Accurate copying, however, is only the beginning of responsible quotation, not its final ____3____.

A speaker may qualify a claim in the next sentence. Removing that qualification can make a limited statement appear ____4____. The quoted words remain unchanged while the ____5____ of the claim expands beyond what the speaker defended.

Context affects reference too. "This approach failed" means little unless readers know which approach and under what conditions. A quotation that removes those links may be memorable but difficult to ____6____.

Not every omission misleads; one sentence cannot repeat an entire conversation. The relevant issue is whether the omitted material would significantly ____7____ the conclusion being drawn. Selection is unavoidable; pretending that it has no consequences is not.

Writers can make their choices more ____8____ by identifying the source and explaining the specific point the quotation supports. If the evidence is narrow, the accompanying claim should remain ____9____ too. A short line should not silently become a complete account of a person's views.

Readers also have a role. When a phrase seems surprisingly convenient for a strong argument, it may be worth looking at the surrounding ____10____. This means distinguishing the exactness of the words from the ____11____ of the use made of them.

The distinction protects both criticism and understanding. A genuine disagreement can be examined more precisely when the position is represented ____12____. Correcting an unfair quotation does not require agreeing with the original speaker. It requires enough care to challenge what was actually ____13____, rather than an easier version created by removal.

Quoting is therefore more than a mechanical act of ____14____. It interprets another voice. Done carefully, it gives that voice a useful place in a new discussion without pretending that the new setting is the ____15____ one.
